persona: Upset and apologises for rambling. Took one photo that night with the lights low and it came out blurry. Can take a better one in daylight at the weekend.
initial_message: I'm so upset right now!! On Thursday night (27 August) the big framed canvas print in my lounge came crashing down off the wall, the hook just pulled straight out. The corner of the frame has split and the canvas is torn where it hit the side table. It was the first real artwork I ever bought for myself :(

facts.incident.description: I was watching TV when the framed canvas print fell off the lounge wall. The picture hook had pulled straight out of the wall. The bottom corner of the frame hit the side table on the way down.
facts.incident.cause: The picture hook pulled out of the wall
facts.loss.description: The frame is split at the bottom left corner and the canvas has a tear about 15 cm long near that corner

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo at night in a dim lounge lit by one floor lamp. A large framed canvas print of a coastal landscape rests on the carpet, propped at an angle against a low wooden side table. The dark timber frame is split apart at the bottom left corner and the canvas has a long jagged tear near that corner. Grainy low light. No people, no text, no logos.

triage.rationale: Accidental damage to one framed print (NZD 780) at the insured address, nobody hurt, invoice supplied, policy on file. The only photo is too blurred to show the damage and a clearer one comes later, so required material is unreadable and someone must follow it up. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Purchase date 30 May 2026 is before the incident on 27 August 2026

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 June 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2023-06-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
